provisional_family_boundary.name: Existing one-way reverse-return append boundary
provisional_family_boundary.focal_trigger: An update_reservation_flights attempt on an existing one_way reservation proposes a complete ordered itinerary that preserves/reaches the original destination and then returns toward the original origin within the same reservation.
provisional_family_boundary.focal_violation: Appending the reverse return to the existing one-way reservation.
provisional_family_boundary.legal_success_path: Leave the existing outbound reservation unchanged and create the requested reverse travel as a separate one-way reservation.
natural_nontrigger_paths: replace or expand an existing one-way itinerary with connections while retaining its original origin and terminal destination
create an independent reverse one-way reservation
excluded_from_this_family: generic destination replacement to a third city
settlement-baseline, budget, certificate, baggage, or passenger-cardinality decisions
any claim that the stored flight_type field itself changed

overlap.reason: Both can be represented as preservation of an existing reservation's route endpoints. LGV16B-004 is currently distinguishable only as the reverse-return append topology, while LGA04 covers direct destination replacement.
overlap.decision_required: Before reconstruction contract, decide whether one general endpoint-preservation rule with two trigger topologies is preferable to two families.

derivation: resolve each proposed flight_number/date against the replay pre-state flight catalog
detect a proposal that reaches the original destination and subsequently returns to the original origin
emit append-only violation evidence at the update attempt step
risk_notes: route continuity and indirect reverse returns need explicit zero-model cases
the rule may be better implemented as one endpoint-preservation rule shared with LGA04

decision.reason: Historical headroom and repair are strong, and deterministic evaluation is feasible, but independent-family identity is not yet established.
